clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked into the hills just north of Agamand Mills, the Agamand Family Crypt is the ancient resting ground of one of Tirisfal's wealthiest farming dynasties. Now claimed by the Scourge under Captain Dargol, its tombs have been ripped open, and the slumbering ancestors raised as mindless terrors.

Before the Third War, the Agamand family held expansive estates across northern Tirisfal Glades, entombing their forebears within this hillside mausoleum. When the Plague brought ruin to the kingdom, the crypt fell into the clutches of Captain Dargol, an agent of the Scourge. Rather than letting the wealthy lineage rest in peace, Dargol employed dark necromancy to awaken the entombed skeletons and vengeful apparitions, transforming a sacred burial ground into an aggressive Scourge foothold right on the edge of Forsaken territory.
